usage: st slopminer [-h] [--version]
                 {review,profile,inspect,jev-request,scope,classify,capture-script} ...

Find unclear, unnecessary or overloaded product copy.

positional arguments:
  {review,profile,inspect,jev-request,scope,classify,capture-script}
    review              Review a snapshot or supplied text against a profile
    profile             Validate a requirements profile
    inspect             Present a snapshot and all pending profile guidance
                        without evaluation
    jev-request         Compile a Jev request for the caller's managed
                        transport; does not dispatch
    scope               Select one complete captured component subtree
    classify            Compile or replay an experimental Jev classification
    capture-script      Print a read-only extractor for the caller's browser
                        eval capability

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
